_comment: Cards for tests/unit/triggers/test_life_paid_to_activate.py. Never part of a deck list. `t_lpa_copier` is Verrak, Warped Sengir's trigger without the creature body: a noncreature artifact. `t_lpa_drainer` pays 2 life for 'each opponent loses 3 life', so the copy is visible on the opponent's total and the second payment on its controller's. `t_lpa_font` is a {G/P} drain, payable with a Forest or 2 life. `t_lpa_watcher` is the same trigger read the other way (`life_paid_to_activate: false`). t_mutator ({G}: +1/+1) is the shared ability that pays no life.

cards.name: Test Life Copier
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you activate an ability that isn't a mana ability, if life was paid to activate it, you may pay that much life again. If you do, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.

abilities.text: Whenever you activate an ability that isn't a mana ability, if life was paid to activate it, you may pay that much life again. If you do, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.

effects.prompt: Pay that much life again to copy that ability?

cards.name: Test Lifeless Watcher
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you activate an ability that isn't a mana ability, if no life was paid to activate it, each opponent loses 1 life.

abilities.text: Whenever you activate an ability that isn't a mana ability, if no life was paid to activate it, each opponent loses 1 life.

cards.name: Test Life Drainer
cards.oracle_text: Pay 2 life: Each opponent loses 3 life.
